PERCENT8.2 rule: s = 100*x rounded half up to 2 decimals + '%'; if len(s) > 6 (= w - 2, SAS keeps room for the parentheses of a negative) retry with 1 decimal, then 0: so 1.0 prints '100.0%', NOT f'{100*x:.2f}%' = '100.00%'. 8.2 / 8.4 = round half up to 2 / 4 decimals. The last decile's cum_capture_rate is always 1 whenever any default exists, so the overflow is hit on every input
